description: Implementation of CustomerOption data access object (DAO) for database operations related to customer options, including listing by store, retrieving by ID or code, and save/update functionality.

classes.name: CustomerOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerOption entity, providing methods for listing, retrieving, and saving customer options.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOption objects for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption by store and option code.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOption or updates an existing one, throws ServiceException on failure.
